items.text: Kickoff flexed from 4:25 to 1:00 p.m. ET. Philadelphia QB: Jalen Hurts out for the season (blood clots); Joe Milton III starts again (matches schedule).

Early-week (Tue) note; first official practice reports come Wednesday. Philadelphia (off a bye): OUT before bye - WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring), CB Jonathan Jones, LB Jihaad Campbell, WR Dontayvion Wicks. QUESTIONABLE - LB Zack Baun (back). RB Will Shipley designated to return from IR.

Early-week (Tue) note; first official practice reports come Wednesday. Pittsburgh: DOUBTFUL last week - G Mason McCormick (ankle); OUT - S DeShon Elliott (knee). WRs Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) and Roman Wilson (finger) on IR but hoped back this week. Aaron Rodgers starts.
